sections.title: CENTRAL/SRN APPALACHIANS AND VICINITY THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: CONVECTION HAS DEVELOPED AS OF LATE MORNING ACROSS CENTRAL WV ...ALONG A REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM EARLY MORNING STORMS IN OH. FARTHER S...A SMALL MCV PERSISTS OVER SE WV. STRONG SURFACE HEATING IS UNDERWAY IN ADVANCE OF THE OUTFLOW AND MCV...WHERE AFTERNOON MLCAPE SHOULD INCREASE TO THE 2500-4000 J/KG RANGE WITH STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND MINIMAL CONVECTIVE INHIBITION. THUS...IT APPEARS LIKELY THAT ADDITIONAL STORMS WILL FORM ALONG THE OUTFLOW AND WITH THE MCV...AS WELL AS OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN. ANTICYCLONIC FLOW AROUND THE MID MS VALLEY UPPER HIGH WILL SUPPORT SWD MOTION OF THE INITIAL STORMS IN THE WV AREA...AND A TENDENCY FOR MORE SWWD MOTION OF THE CLUSTER LATER THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS ERN KY/TN. DAMAGING WINDS SHOULD BE THE MAIN CONCERN BASED ON STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...LARGE DCAPE...AND PRECIPITATION LOADING IN THE ENVIRONMENT WITH PW VALUES OF 1.50-1.75 INCHES. MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE GIVEN THE LARGE BUOYANCY...BUT RELATIVELY WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR WILL TEND TO LIMIT UPDRAFT LONGEVITY AND INDIVIDUAL STORM ORGANIZATION. ...SMALL PART OF SE PA/MD THIS AFTERNOON.. THE ERN EXTENT OF THE OH/PA OUTFLOW BOUNDARY APPEARS TO INTERSECT THE SYNOPTIC FRO

sections.title: ERN WY/SD AREA THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: SURFACE CYCLOGENESIS IS EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS CENTRAL/ERN WY IN ADVANCE OF A SERIES OF SPEED MAXIMA ALOFT EJECTING NNEWD FROM THE GREAT BASIN. IN RESPONSE TO THE PRESSURE FALLS ACROSS WY...THE STALLED SURFACE FRONT IN NEB WILL MOVE NWD TO NEAR THE NEB/SD BORDER BY THIS EVENING. A CORRIDOR OF RICHER BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE HAS BEEN MAINTAINED NEAR AND JUST N OF THE FRONT...AND THIS MOISTURE WILL CONTRIBUTE TO MODERATE-STRONG INSTABILITY ALONG AND JUST N OF THE WARM FRONT...THOUGH MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE NOT AS STEEP AS PRIOR DAYS AS A RESULT OF PRIOR CONVECTION OVER THE HIGH PLAINS AND PLATEAU. RESIDUAL CLOUDS DO COMPLICATE THE SCENARIO ACROSS NRN NEB/SRN SD...AS WELL AS ERN WY...WHERE SURFACE HEATING WILL BE LIMITED SOME THROUGH AT LEAST EARLY AFTERNOON. ALSO...DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR WILL NOT BE PARTICULARLY STRONG. A FEW STORMS COULD FORM ALONG THE WARM FRONT THIS AFTERNOON AND POSE A RISK FOR ISOLATED LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS...THOUGH THE MORE PROBABLE AREA FOR AT LEAST MARGINAL SUPERCELL POTENTIAL WILL BE FROM EXTREME SW SD INTO E/NE WY WHERE MORE CLOUD BREAKS ARE EXPECTED...AND IN CLOSER PROXIMITY TO SOMEWHAT STRONGER FLOW ALOFT. OTHERWISE...A PRONOUNCED WARM ADVE

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE/MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS EAST-CENTRAL OH IN THE SHORT-TERM...AND PERHAPS DEVELOP INTO SOUTH-CENTRAL/SOUTHEAST OH AND ADJACENT FAR NORTHERN WV THROUGH MID/LATE MORNING. SEVERE TSTM WATCH 468 CONTINUES...AND CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR AN ADDITIONAL WATCH TO THE SOUTH OF WW 468.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A PERSISTENT SOUTHEASTWARD MOVING MCS/ASSOCIATED GUST FRONT CONTINUES TO STEADILY PROGRESS SOUTH-SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS EAST-CENTRAL/NORTHEAST OH AS OF 1145Z. A 47 KT WIND GUST WAS RECENTLY /1138Z/ MEASURED AT THE WOOSTER-WAYNE CITY ASOS. THE INTEGRITY OF THE CONVECTIVE LINE/ASSOCIATED LIGHTING HAS DIMINISHED ESPECIALLY ON ITS EASTERN EXTENT...AS IT ENCOUNTERS A MORE STABLE AIRMASS TOWARD WESTERN PA. NONETHELESS...CURRENT FORWARD MOTION OF THE MCS/ASSOCIATED GUST FRONT WILL CONTINUE TO ACCOUNT FOR THE POSSIBILITY OF WIND DAMAGE ACROSS THE EASTERN HALF OF OH AND PERHAPS NORTHERN WV/FAR WESTERN PA...WITH THE STRONGEST UPDRAFTS/MOST SUSTAINED UPLIFT LIKELY TO REMAIN ON THE WEST/SOUTHWESTERN-MOST FLANK OF THE MCS/GUST FRONT. THE NEED FOR A WATCH TO THE SOUTH OF WW 468 IS UNCERTAIN IN THE SHORT TERM...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED...AND AT THE VERY LEAST...A LOCAL WFO EXTENSION /AREA/ MAY BE WARRANTED. ..GUYER.. 07/05/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT APPEARS LIKELY TO DEVELOP ACROSS THE CNTRL APPALACHIAN MTNS LATE THIS MORNING INTO THIS AFTERNOON. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND WIND DAMAGE WILL LIKELY BE THE PRIMARY THREATS. WW ISSUANCE COULD BECOME NECESSARY ONCE THE MAGNITUDE OF THE SEVERE THREAT BECOMES MORE CERTAIN.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SHORT LINE SEGMENT OF STRONG THUNDERSTORMS CURRENTLY IN NWRN WV IS LOCATED ON A GRADIENT OF MODERATE INSTABILITY EXTENDING SEWD INTO WRN VA. MESOANALYSIS ESTIMATES MLCAPE VALUES IN THE 2000 TO 3000 J/KG RANGE AHEAD OF THE PATH OF THE LINE SEGMENT. IN ADDITION...THE WSR-88D VWP AT CHARLESTON WV SHOWS ABOUT 30 KT OF DEEP LAYER SHEAR SUGGESTING ENOUGH FLOW IS PRESENT FOR AN ORGANIZED SEVERE THREAT. IN ADDITION...LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE ALREADY BECOMING STEEP ACROSS THE CNTRL APPALACHIAN MTNS WITH 0-3 KM LAPSE RATES ESTIMATED TO BE AROUND 8.0 C/KM. AS INSTABILITY CONTINUES TO INCREASE LATE THIS MORNING AND LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES STEEPEN FURTHER...THE LINE SHOULD GRADUALLY INTENSIFY. THIS SHOULD RESULT IN AN INCREASING THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS DEVELOPING. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL MAY ALSO ACCOMPANY THE STRONGER CORES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ACROSS THE SRN APPALACHIAN MTNS THIS AFTERNOON. THE STRONGER CORES SHOULD BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL. WW ISSUANCE REMAINS POSSIBLE ACROSS THE MCD AREA THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE AIRMASS ACROSS THE SRN APPALACHIAN MTNS HAS BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE THIS AFTERNOON WITH MESOANALYSIS ESTIMATING MLCAPES RANGING FROM 2000 J/KG IN ERN AL TO NEAR 3000 J/KG IN ERN TN. IN ADDITION...SFC TEMPS HAVE WARMED INTO THE LOWER 90S F ACROSS MUCH OF THE SRN APPALACHIAN MTNS AND 0-3 KM LAPSE RATES ARE NOW ESTIMATED TO BE AROUND 8.0 C/KM. THIS COMBINED WITH UNIDIRECTIONAL WIND PROFILES AND WEAK NLY FLOW SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR SLOW SWD MOVING PULSE STORMS. THE STRONGER DOWNBURSTS COULD BE ACCOMPANIED WITH DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL THIS AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP FROM THE MID-ATLANTIC SWWD INTO THE CAROLINAS. A MARGINALLY SEVERE DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGER CORES. THE THREATS SHOULD REMAIN TOO ISOLATED FOR WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A LEE SFC TROUGH IN PLACE FROM SERN VA SWWD ACROSS THE CAROLINAS. CELLS ARE STARTING TO INITIATE ON THE NRN SIDE OF THE SFC TROUGH WHERE MODERATE INSTABILITY HAS DEVELOPED THIS AFTERNOON. MLCAPE VALUES ARE ESTIMATED IN THE 1000 TO 2500 J/KG RANGE WITH THE STRONGEST INSTABILITY ALONG AND SOUTH OF THE SFC TROUGH OVER ERN SC AND SRN NC. THIS COMBINED WITH 0-3 KM LAPSE RATES OF 8.0 TO 9.0 C/KM AND WEAK DEEP LAYER SHEAR EVIDENT ON REGIONAL WSR-88D VWPS SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR MARGINALLY SEVERE PULSE STORMS. THE STRONGER CORES COULD BRIEFLY PRODUCE MARGINALLY SEVERE DOWNBURSTS AND HAIL OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT CONTINUES FOR SRN PTN WW 469 FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AHEAD OF CONVECTIVE LINE DROPPING S/SWD THROUGH WV AND INTO ERN KY...WRN VA AND EVENTUALLY NERN TN AND NWRN NC.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ORGANIZED CONVECTION CONTINUE TO MOVE S/SWD INTO VERY MOIST UNSTABLE AIR MASS WITH MLCAPE IN EXCESS OF 3000 J/KG OVER ERN KY. ALSO... NEWER STORMS CONTINUE TO FIRE ALONG WESTERN SIDE OF WATCH AS ENTIRE COMPLEX MOVES S/SWD. AS STORM COVERAGE CONTINUES TO INCREASE...SEVERE THREAT IN WRN PTN WATCH MAY SHIFT MORE TO LARGE HAIL WITH DAMAGING WINDS STILL MORE THE THREAT IN THE CNTRL/ERN PTN OF THE WATCH. NEW WW MAY BE POSSIBLE GENERALLY SW OF WW 469 ACROSS PTNS MIDDLE/ERN TN AND SCNTRL KY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT MAY DEVELOP ACROSS SE LOWER MI...NW OH AND NE IND LATE THIS AFTERNOON. WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL SHOULD BE THE PRIMARY THREATS. HOWEVER...THE THREATS SHOULD REMAIN ISOLATED AND WW ISSUANCE REMAINS UNCERTAIN ATTM.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS IS ONGOING IN SERN LOWER MI LOCATED ON THE NRN EDGE OF MODERATE INSTABILITY. THE ACTIVITY APPEARS TO BE NEAR AN OLD OUTFLOW BOUNDARY WHERE LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE IS LOCALLY ENHANCED. MLCAPE VALUES ARE ESTIMATED AROUND 1500 J/KG RANGE WITH 0-3 KM LAPSE RATES LIKELY EXCEEDING 8.0 C/KM FROM THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY TO THE SOUTHWEST ACROSS FAR NW OH AND NE IND. THIS ALONG WITH A TENDENCY FOR THE STORMS TO BECOME INCREASINGLY SFC-BASED LATE THIS AFTERNOON...MAY RESULT IN A GRADUAL INTENSIFICATION. THE STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES MAY RESULT IN AN ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE THREAT ESPECIALLY IF THE CELLS CAN ORGANIZE INTO A LINE. THIS MAY DEPEND UPON WHETHER THE ACTIVITY CAN ACCESS THE STRONGER INSTABILITY TO THE SOUTH. IN ADDITION TO THE WIND DAMAGE THREAT...HAIL WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGER UPDRAFT CORES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT EXPECTED NEXT 1 TO 2 HOURS IN CNTRL PA. DAMAGING WIND SHOULD BE MAIN THREAT INTO LATE AFTERNOON WITH ISOLATED LARGE HAIL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ALTHOUGH SFC WINDS ARE W/NWLY...TEMPERATURE HAVE CLIMBED INTO THE MID 90S AND DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE UPPER 60S TO NEAR 70. MLCAPE IS IN EXCESS OF 3000 J/KG. MODEL FORECASTS THE CAPPING INVERSION OVER THE AREA SHOULD CONTINUE TO WEAKEN ALLOWING STORMS TO DEVELOP. SATELLITE ALSO INDICATES CU FIELD IS BECOMING MORE ENHANCED ON VIS IMAGERY. DAMAGING WINDS AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL COULD BE POSSIBLE ONCE THE STORMS FORM AND A WATCH IS POSSIBLE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT MAY DEVELOP AS STORMS INCREASE IN COVERAGE ACROSS ERN WY AND FAR WRN SD. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS ARE EXPECTED TO BE THE PRIMARY THREATS AND WW ISSUANCE MAY BE NEEDED LATE THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS ARE DEVELOPING FROM JUST WEST OF LARAMIE NWD TO NEAR CASPER ALONG A ZONE OF LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE AND JUST TO THE EAST OF 1005 MB SFC LOW. A NARROW CORRIDOR OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE IS PRESENT TO THE EAST OF THE SFC LOW ACROSS ERN WY WHERE SFC DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE MID 50S TO NEAR 60 F. IN RESPONSE TO SFC HEATING...MODERATE INSTABILITY HAS DEVELOPED ALONG MOST OF THE MCD AREA WITH MESOANALYSIS ESTIMATING MLCAPE VALUES IN THE 1000 TO 1500 J/KG RANGE. IN ADDITION...FORECAST SOUNDINGS ACROSS ERN WY SUGGEST 30 TO 40 KT OF DEEP LAYER SHEAR IS PRESENT. THIS MAY BE ENOUGH TO SUPPORT A SEVERE THREAT WITH THE MORE INTENSE CELLS THAT REMAIN DISCRETE AND ROTATE. INITIALLY...THE GREATEST SEVERE THREAT FOR HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS SHOULD BE IN THE SRN PART OF THE MCD WHERE LAPSE RATES ARE STEEPER THAN IN AREAS TO THE NORTH. THE SEVERE THREAT COULD INCREASE ACROSS THE NRN PART OF THE MCD AFTER A FEW MORE HOURS WHEN LOW-LEVEL FLOW IS FORECAST TO INCREASE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ONGOING STORMS OVER SERN MI INTO NWRN OH MAY CONTINUE TO EVOLVE AND POSE A DAMAGING WIND THREAT TO NRN INDIANA INTO WRN/CNTRL OH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SURFACE ANALYSIS AND VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOW AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY MOVING SWWD FROM SRN MI SEWD ACROSS CNTRL OH. THE AIR MASS NEAR THIS BOUNDARY REMAINS VERY UNSTABLE...WITH MID TO UPPER 60S F DEWPOINTS. RADAR TRENDS INDICATE SOME CLUSTERING OF STORMS NOW ENTERING NWRN OH OUT OF MI...AND THIS AREA MAY HAVE THE BEST CHANCE OF GROWING UPSCALE AND BECOMING SEVERE. THE SRN EXTENT OF THE SEVERE THREAT SHOULD STOP NEAR THE OH RIVER WHERE THE AIR MASS WAS RECENTLY OVERTURNED...AND SWWD INTO CNTRL IND WHERE LOWER PWAT EXISTS WITH DEWPOINTS INTO THE 59-61 F RANGE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS CONTINUE TO INCREASE OVER CNTRL/SRN NC...AND MAY PERSIST IN A SEMI-ORGANIZED FASHION INTO SC WITH A WIND AND HAIL THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS HAVE SOLIDIFIED ALONG AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ACROSS S CNTRL NC. THE AIR MASS REMAINS VERY UNSTABLE AREA-WIDE...WITH WEAK STEERING CURRENTS OUT OF THE N. THESE STORMS MAY EVENTUALLY PROPAGATE SWD WITH A WIND THREAT OVER A CONCENTRATED AREA AND A WATCH MAY BE REQUIRED. HOWEVER...IF CELLS CONTINUE TO MAINLY PULSE...SUFFICIENT OUTFLOW MAY NOT BE PRODUCED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A THREAT FOR ISOLATED DMGG WIND GUSTS/HAIL...AND PERHAPS LAND SPOUTS...WILL EXIST THROUGH THE NEXT COUPLE HOURS. SPARSE COVERAGE OF THE THREAT SHOULD PRECLUDE WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED TSTMS HAVE DEVELOPED NEAR A WEAKLY CONVERGENT FRONT STRETCHING E-W NEAR THE NEB/SD BORDER. VERY RICH BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE...WITH SFC DEW POINTS IN THE UPPER 60S-LOWER 70S...IS CONTRIBUTING TO A STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS WITH MLCAPE VALUES OF 3000-4000 J/KG. DEEP-LAYER FLOW FIELDS ARE QUITE WEAK PER FSD VWP DATA...BUT ELY WINDS ALONG/N OF THE BOUNDARY COULD RESULT IN LOCAL ENHANCEMENT OF LOW-LEVEL VORTICITY. THIS...COMBINED WITH STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES OWING TO STRONG BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING AND SLOW STORM MOTIONS...COULD RESULT IN A LAND SPOUT OR TWO AS STORMS INTERACT WITH THE BOUNDARY. ISOLATED DMGG WIND GUSTS AND/OR LARGE HAIL CANNOT BE RULED OUT...BUT GREATER COVERAGE SHOULD BE LIMITED BY THE PRESENCE OF MIDLEVEL ANTICYCLONE POSITIONED JUST SE OF THE AREA.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE ORIGINAL MCS APPEARS TO BE DWINDLING ACROSS ERN TN...BUT SOME INCREASE IN STORMS MAY CONTINUE ACROSS MIDDLE TN INTO NERN AL AND NRN GA. HAIL AND WIND ALL POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE TN MCS CONTINUES TO EXHIBIT WARMING CLOUD TOPS AS WELL AS A POOR RADAR PRESENTATION...ALTHOUGH A FEW STRONGER CELLS REMAIN ALONG THE LEADING GUST FRONT. OF NOTE HAS BEEN THE INCREASE IN STRONG TO SEVERE CORES TO THE W...IN AN AXIS FROM MIDDLE TN INTO NERN AL AND NRN GA. THIS GENERAL ZONE APPEARS TO BE MORE UNSTABLE WITH SEVERAL SEVERE HAIL CORES NOTED. AS THE DYING MCS INTERACTS WITH THESE AREAS...THERE MAY BE AN INCREASE IN STRONG TO SEVERE CONVECTION OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. WEAK WIND CONVERGENCE WAS ALSO NOTED ACROSS NRN GA WHICH MAY FORCE MORE STRONG TO SEVERE PULSE STORMS. ..JEWELL.. 07/05/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN UPGRADE TO A TORNADO WATCH IS BEING CONSIDERED SOON ACROSS NRN PARTS OF WW 472.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE POTENTIAL FOR A TORNADO OR TWO MAY INCREASE THIS EVENING. RADAR TRENDS SHOW INCREASING INTENSITY OF DISCRETE STORMS FROM NERN WY TOWARDS THE BLACK HILLS OF WRN SD...WITH ONE SUPERCELL LOCATED OVER CAMPBELL COUNTY WY. SFC OBS/VWP DATA SHOW A CORRIDOR OF 20-30 KT LOW-LEVEL FLOW EXTENDING ACROSS W-CNTRL SD NWWD INTO SERN MT. FORECAST MODEL GUIDANCE IS CONSISTENT IN SHOWING STRENGTHENING FLOW NEAR 2 KM AGL AFTER 00Z...WHILE LOW-LEVEL FLOW BACKS SLIGHTLY...YIELDING MORE FAVORABLE LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS. THUS...AN UPGRADE TO A TORNADO WATCH IS BEING CONSIDERED SOON FOR NRN PARTS OF WW 472.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR DMGG WIND/HAIL...AND PERHAPS A TORNADO OR TWO...CONTINUES ACROSS WW 473. MAIN THREAT SHOULD EVENTUALLY SHIFT FARTHER N/E WITH TIME AS THE LLJ STRENGTHENS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ALTHOUGH INITIAL STRONG-SVR TSTMS OVER PARTS OF NERN WY AND WRN SD HAVE WEAKENED WITH NWD MOVEMENT INTO A DRIER/MORE STABLE AIR MASS...STORMS FARTHER S/W HAVE RE-INTENSIFIED WITHIN THE PAST HR. SVR STORMS OVER FAR ERN WY AND THE NEB PANHANDLE ARE EXPECTED TO EVENTUALLY MOVE INTO WW 473....WHILE A CLUSTER OVER THE BLACK HILLS OF SWRN SD APPEARS TO BECOMING BETTER ORGANIZED. REDUCTION OF AVAILABLE INSTABILITY DUE TO DIURNAL COOLING MAY BE OFFSET SOMEWHAT BY A MOISTENING BOUNDARY LAYER OVER PARTS OF WRN SD...WHERE DEW POINTS ARE GENERALLY IN THE UPPER 60S. WITH TIME...LOW-LEVEL JET AND RESULTANT WAA SHOULD INCREASE OVER WRN/CNTRL SD...AND SHOULD FAVOR EVENTUAL EWD/NWD SHIFT IN FOCUS FOR NEW CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT. ADDITIONALLY...HODOGRAPHS WILL REMAIN FAVORABLE FOR TORNADOES IF STORMS CAN REMAIN SFC-BASED.
